name: Arctibax
description: Arctibax, the Ice Fin Pokémon, and the evolved form of Frigibax. Able to evolve into Baxcalibur. A Dragon and Ice type.
pokedex_entries: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax's strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
